decisions: Split editor-view.tsx into editor-top-bar/editor-tool-rail/editor-zoom-control/editor-resource-panel/editor-properties-panel/editor-more-sheet/editor-help-dialog per task.md's decomposition guidance, and to stop duplicating desktop/mobile panel JSX.

Built the full 12-tool prototype rail now, but only text/image/background were functional in slice 1; the other tools render an explicit ToolComingSoon notice instead of a silent or fake panel, since their real functionality belongs to later execution-plan slices.
Preview and Hoàn tất show an honest live-region limitation notice instead of a fake success or silent no-op, since both flows are owned by later slices.

Used a component-local aria-live announcement region for limitation/status notices instead of the shared global toast(), because the shared Toaster is only mounted by app/providers.tsx which the existing EditorView unit test intentionally renders without.

draftStatus (unsaved/saving/saved/error) is driven only by the existing manual Lưu bản nháp button plus a real unversioned localStorage write (lib/editor/draft-storage.ts); debounced autosave with schema/version stays with the Lưu nháp, history và bảo vệ dữ liệu slice.
Did not add a Ctrl/⌘+S shortcut; task.md assigns it to the Lưu nháp, history và bảo vệ dữ liệu slice.

Kept a single shared <input type=file> (desktop panel only, triggered via a shared ref from both desktop and mobile) instead of letting the reusable EditorResourcePanel render its own input in each usage, to avoid two inputs racing on one ref.

Slice 2: made the 'Mẫu' tool implemented (editor-tools.ts) and built EditorOnboardingDialog/EditorTemplatePanel/EditorTemplateGalleryDialog/EditorTemplateConfirmDialog to replace the old background-only start picker with a real starting-point flow (blank/template/restore-draft, search+occasion/style filters, no-results state, tier/pages metadata, overwrite confirmation).

Slice 2: overwrite-risk signal is editor.hasContent = pagesHaveContent(state.pages) (any page has an element), not history depth — history advances on page/valid-template-load in ways that don't represent destroyable content, while element presence is the literal 'nguy cơ ghi đè nội dung hiện tại' signal.

Slice 2: applyTemplate/restoreDraft go through the normal commit() history path so a template/draft swap stays undoable (Ctrl/⌘+Z), and template application seeds a real editable title text element (+ inner-page greeting placeholder) via lib/editor/apply-template.ts rather than only changing background color — full per-template layout lands with the later canvas/text-tool slices since CardElement only models text/image today.

Slice 2: loadCardDraft() in draft-storage.ts does a shape-only safety check (never throws) for onboarding's restore option; full schema/version migration remains owned by the Lưu nháp, history và bảo vệ dữ liệu slice.

Slice 3: extended CardElementType to text/image/frame/shape/qr/video/event and gave EditorElement a per-type renderer; no tool panel adds frame/shape/qr/video/event yet (owned by later slices) but the render/select/transform/lock/hide/z-order/align model applies uniformly to all 7 types today, verified via createCardElement in tests.

Slice 3: added lib/editor/canvas-geometry.ts as a pure, unit-tested module for bounds clamping, snap-guide computation, resize-handle math and align-to-canvas, kept separate from the reducer and pointer-event wiring per task.md's reducer/pure-transitions guidance.

Slice 3: EditorElement divides every pointer delta by a canvasScale prop before applying drag/resize, and rotation uses the element's real bounding-rect center, so interaction stays correct at any zoom (not just 100%).

Slice 3: every geometry patch (drag/resize/nudge/align) is clamped to canvas bounds centrally in useCardEditor.updateElement, not only at the pointer-event layer, so no interaction source can independently drift out of bounds.
Slice 3: bringForward/sendBackward (one-step reorder) are separate from bringToFront/sendToBack (absolute), per 'không chỉ front/back tuyệt đối'.

Slice 3: locked elements stay selectable/deletable but reject geometry patches (isGeometryPatch guard); hidden elements are filtered from canvas rendering but stay reachable/toggleable via the properties panel — both reversible, neither ever drops the element from state.

Slice 3: document-level Escape always deselects first (even while typing in a text field), Ctrl/⌘+Z and Ctrl/⌘+Shift+Z are suppressed while focus is in an input/textarea/contentEditable, and arrow-nudge/Enter-to-edit/Delete are scoped to each EditorElement's own onKeyDown so an unrelated focused control can never trigger them.
Slice 3: setActivePageIndex always resets selectedElementId to null on the same commit, so selection can never reference an element from a page that is no longer active.

Slice 3: added 2 regression tests (Escape-deselect, Ctrl+Z-suppressed-while-typing) that the pre-existing suite didn't directly cover, and fixed 3 pre-existing type errors (RefObject<T|null> vs textarea ref contract, closure-narrowed duplicate-element variable, unreachable 'in' guard in test/setup.ts) left in the worktree from an earlier incomplete session so typecheck could pass.

Slice 3: reused SWATCH.ink/SWATCH.rose from lib/mock/swatches.ts for element-defaults.ts's per-type default colors instead of new raw hex, since the raw literal would have newly tripped establish-frontend-design-system's repeated-color gate on its own.

Slice 3: stopped a stray leftover `next dev -p 3100` process in this worktree before running the production build — it was racing the same .next directory and causing non-deterministic build failures; disposable, not part of any in-progress work.

Slice 4 ("Công cụ văn bản"): replaced EditorResourcePanel's single generic 'Thêm khối văn bản' button with a new EditorTextPanel (6 quick-add presets from lib/editor/text-presets.ts plus a grouped/searchable greeting library from lib/mock/wishes.ts); extended CardElement with fontFamily/italic/underline/lineHeight/letterSpacing/opacity (opacity rendered for every element type); added lib/editor/text-fonts.ts self-hosting the prototype's 7-font list via next/font/google; extended the properties panel with a content textarea, font-family select, bold/italic/underline toggle group, and line-height/letter-spacing/opacity sliders (and removed a previously-inconsistent `disabled={element.locked}` from these non-geometry controls); added editor-floating-text-toolbar.tsx (role=toolbar, positioned near the selected text element, plain focusable controls for full keyboard operability); extended useCardEditor.addElement with an optional overrides param; refactored apply-template.ts's title/greeting element builders to use createCardElement.

Slice 4: discovered mid-implementation that next/font/google (used by the new lib/editor/text-fonts.ts) throws under Vitest without a mock, and that a naive catch-all `vi.mock` Proxy hangs the entire test run (module-namespace-as-thenable trap) — fixed in apps/public-web/test/setup.ts with a Proxy `get` trap that excludes `then`/symbols plus a `has` trap; proposed as a knowledge_updates entry for ai/repos/frontend/testing.md (not edited directly, per common.md's ban on direct ai/repos edits — this was caught and reverted after an initial mistaken direct edit).

Slice 5 ("Ảnh, khung ảnh và trang trí"): read the prototype's pnlImage()/handleFiles()/pnlDeco()/pnlFrame()/propsImage()/propsFrame() to extract the exact accept list (JPG/JPEG/PNG/WEBP), 8MB size cap, 4 sample-photo gradients, 5 decoration groups (10 shape ids) and 8 frame presets. Added lib/editor/image-library.ts (validateImageFile/createLibraryPhoto/isUrlUsedOnCanvas/SAMPLE_PHOTOS/samplePhotoImageSrc) and lib/editor/decorations.ts (DECORATION_GROUPS/FRAME_PRESETS), reusing SWATCH.* tokens for every color instead of new raw hex (same repeated-color-gate reasoning as slice 3's element-defaults.ts). Extended CardElement with borderRadius/flipX/flipY. Added 3 new tool-panel components (editor-image-panel.tsx, editor-frame-panel.tsx, editor-deco-panel.tsx) wired into editor-resource-panel.tsx, replacing the old single-file/no-validation upload button; marked `deco`/`frame` implemented in editor-tools.ts (deco also added to BASIC_TOOL_IDS, matching the prototype's `simple` tool list; frame stays advanced-only there too, also matching the prototype).

Slice 5: uploading (file picker, multi-select, or drag-drop) only adds valid files to a temporary on-device photo library (React state lifted to EditorView so the desktop aside and mobile drawer never diverge, mirroring the existing fileInputRef sharing pattern) — placing a photo on the canvas is a separate, explicit click on a library/sample thumbnail. This matches the prototype's pnlImage()/drawLib() flow (upload → thư viện tạm → bấm để thêm vào thiệp), not the previous single-file 'select = place immediately' shortcut.

Slice 5: removing a photo from the library only calls URL.revokeObjectURL when no element on any page still has that URL as its `content` (isUrlUsedOnCanvas scans editor.state.pages) — revoking an object URL an already-placed image element depends on would blank that image out; the prototype avoids this same hazard structurally by keeping the on-canvas `src` on a separate (never-revoked) data URL, which this implementation intentionally does not copy because it would mean re-encoding every upload to base64.

Slice 5: both `image` and `frame` elements' 'Thay ảnh'/'Thêm ảnh vào khung' properties-panel buttons share one hidden file input (`replaceImageInputRef` + `replaceImageTargetId`) instead of one input per element, following the same single-shared-ref precedent as the existing upload input and the existing single-shared file input decision from slice 1.

Slice 5: added `unoptimized` to every canvas `` that can render an `image`/`frame` element's `content` (blob:/data: URLs) — next/image's default loader proxies remote fetches through `/_next/image` server-side and cannot resolve either URL scheme; confirmed via a local `next build` + `next dev` smoke run that the `/tao-thiep` route still compiles and serves. Library/sample thumbnails use a plain `` with the same `@next/next/no-img-element` eslint-disable-next-line justification already established in this codebase's components/custom-order/custom-order-form.tsx for the same blob:-preview reason.

Slice 5: sample photos render via an inline `data:image/svg+xml` gradient (lib/editor/image-library.ts's samplePhotoImageSrc) instead of the prototype's `<canvas>.toDataURL()` round trip — same visual result (a gradient placeholder image `content`), no `HTMLCanvasElement.getContext('2d')` dependency that jsdom doesn't implement, so the exact same code path renders correctly in both the browser and the Vitest suite.

Slice 5: added a `DecorativeShapeGlyph` export from editor-element.tsx (shared by the canvas element renderer and editor-deco-panel.tsx's picker grid) so the decoration library's preview always matches what actually gets placed, instead of maintaining two separate shape-path tables that could drift; extended it with `sparkle` (filled) and `flower`/`leaf`/`ribbon`/`stamp` (stroke-only line-art, matching the prototype's `shapeSvg()` line()-vs-wrap() split) on top of the existing heart/star/circle/square/triangle.

Slice 5: 'Xóa nền' (remove background) is a real button in the image properties panel that only calls the existing `announce()` live-region helper with 'Tính năng Xóa nền — Sắp có.' (the prototype's exact toast text) — no state changes, no fake success, per the requirement's explicit example of a not-yet-real capability.

Slice 5: opacity/thứ tự lớp (layer order) needed no new image-specific code — opacity was already rendered for every element type since slice 4, and bringForward/sendBackward/bringToFront/sendToBack were already generic across all element types since slice 3; only added the opacity *slider* to the image section of the properties panel (parallel to the pre-existing text section) since layer-order controls already sit outside the per-type block. 'Xoay' (rotate) likewise needed no new code: the canvas rotate handle already applies to every unlocked selected element regardless of type.

Slice 5: added a `URL.createObjectURL`/`URL.revokeObjectURL` polyfill to apps/public-web/test/setup.ts (jsdom implements neither) — same pattern as the existing PointerEvent/setPointerCapture polyfills in that file.

Slice 6 ("Nền và bảng màu"): changed `CardPage.background` (lib/types/editor.ts) from a plain hex string to a typed `PageBackground` (`{type, color, color2?, src?}`, matching the prototype's `pg.bg`) and added lib/editor/background.ts as a pure module (`BACKGROUND_TYPE_PRESETS`/`COLOR_PALETTES` = the prototype's 6 background types and 7 named palettes, `isValidHexColor`/`normalizeHexColor` mirroring the prototype's own hex regex, `backgroundStyle()` mirroring `applyBg()`'s per-type CSS, `applyPaletteToPage()` mirroring `applyPalette()`'s exact color-cycling order).

Slice 6: added editor-background-panel.tsx (preset gallery + swatch/picker/hex color field, wired into the existing 'Nền' tool) and flipped `color` to `implemented: true` with a new editor-color-panel.tsx (7 palettes, per-swatch apply to the selected text/shape element or the background, whole-page palette apply, custom color field, recent-colors row lifted to EditorView like the photo library). Added a shared editor-color-field.tsx (native color picker + validated hex text field; invalid input is rejected with an inline alert and never applied) reused by both new panels.

Slice 6: added 6 new SWATCH tokens so every one of the 7 palettes' colors is expressed via identifiers with zero new raw hex, converted apply-template.ts's two raw-hex background constants to SWATCH tokens, and removed the now-dead BACKGROUND_CHOICES array — incidentally reducing the pre-existing, out-of-scope #EFE2CF design-system finding from 6 to 5.

Slice 6: `applyPaletteToPage()` only ever writes the page background color/type and each text/shape element's `color`; every other element field and type passes through unchanged, so a palette apply can never drop or corrupt existing content.

Slice 6: the canvas's alignment-grid overlay moved from the page-background style object into its own absolutely-positioned sibling `<span>`, avoiding fragile multi-layer CSS background composition now that a page background can itself use `backgroundImage` (gradient/paper/pattern/transparent).

Slice 8 ("Quản lý trang thiệp"): added addPage/duplicatePage/renamePage/deletePage/movePage to use-card-editor.ts (backed by a new pure lib/editor/page-templates.ts#createPage(kind) for the prototype's 4 page kinds — blank/message/photo/event) and a new editor-page-manager.tsx replacing the old read-only page strip; every one of these actions clears selectedElementId in the same history commit, extending the existing setActivePageIndex invariant to every page-identity/order-changing action.

Slice 8: deletePage preserves the previously-active page by id across a removal (falling back to the prototype's own clamp only when the deleted page was itself the active one) — a deliberate improvement over the prototype's literal `Math.max(0, Math.min(i, length-1))`, which silently jumps the viewer to a different page than the one they were looking at when an earlier, non-active page is deleted.

Slice 8: added editor-page-thumbnail.tsx, a small non-interactive renderer (reads page.background/page.elements directly, no snapshot) instead of reusing the interactive EditorElement at a small size, so the page bar's thumbnails always reflect the latest content/background/order and never trigger element pointer/keyboard interactions from a stray click.

Slice 8: added editor-page-delete-dialog.tsx (same Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogTitle shape as editor-template-confirm-dialog.tsx); the last-page-delete guard is duplicated both in the UI (disabled menu item + announce fallback) and inside deletePage itself (no-op on a length-1 document), matching the same defense-in-depth reasoning as updateElement's locked-element guard.

Slice 8: the per-page "..." menu and the "+" add-page kind picker both reuse the existing Popover/PopoverItem primitives already established by editor-zoom-control.tsx's zoom-level menu, instead of a second hand-rolled floating-menu implementation.

Slice 9 ("Lưu nháp, history và bảo vệ dữ liệu"): added CARD_DRAFT_SCHEMA_VERSION to draft-storage.ts and made loadCardDraft() reject any wrong-version or structurally corrupt page/element instead of only checking top-level shape.

Slice 9: removed commit()'s blanket setDraftStatus('unsaved') and replaced it with a debounced autosave useEffect keyed on real content fields (cardName/pages/music) — fixes a real bug where page-navigation-only commits left draftStatus stuck on 'unsaved' forever.

Slice 9: added history-coalescing to updateElement (id + patch-group + historyIndex + 500ms window) so drag/resize/rotate/nudge gestures collapse into one undo step instead of one per pointermove/keydown.

Slice 9: added Ctrl/⌘+S (save) and Ctrl/⌘+D (duplicate selected element) to editor-view.tsx's existing global keydown handler, and a beforeunload listener gated on draftStatus !== 'saved'; kept the existing per-element Delete/arrow-nudge handling in editor-element.tsx unchanged (already satisfies the requirement, avoids double-firing risk).

Slice 10 ("Xem trước"): added a new full-screen EditorPreviewDialog (components/editor/editor-preview-dialog.tsx), wired to the existing top-bar 'Xem trước' button in place of its prior limitation-notice stub. It renders every page via the pre-existing EditorPageThumbnail (already the exact z-order/background/rotation/opacity/hidden-aware renderer used by the page manager since slice 8), so preview needed no second hand-maintained render path. Added phone/tablet/desktop device switching, prev/next + page-dot navigation, a light/dark chrome toggle (never recoloring a page's own background), and a play/pause music control paired with a persistent honest 'chưa chọn nhạc nền'/'(mô phỏng)' status line instead of real audio. The dialog calls no editor mutation, so closing it can never lose editor state; focus-trap/Escape/focus-return-to-trigger come from the shared Dialog primitive (verified by a dedicated toHaveFocus regression). Added 7 new icons (Play/Pause/Moon/Sun/Smartphone/Tablet/Desktop) to icons.tsx. Added a new 'EditorView preview' describe block (3 tests) and split the pre-existing top-bar limitation-notice test so only 'Hoàn tất' keeps that assertion. Confirmed every specific scenario bullet (invalid template, invalid/corrupt draft, invalid file, invalid video link, invalid hex color, last-page delete guard, unsaved-navigation/beforeunload, keyboard shortcuts, responsive drawers) and all 8 happy-path integration flows were already covered by tests written alongside their owning slices (1-12) — verified via targeted greps rather than assumed.
